learnings: Patch files (.patch extension) must not be classified as binary files. The file type detection logic should recognize .patch as a text format and route it for LLM review.
The audit tool should prioritize files that are referenced in PKGBUILD functions (especially prepare(), build(), package()) and ensure they are reviewed even if file type detection is uncertain.
Models should be explicitly prompted that .patch files are text-based diffs and should be analyzed for malicious code injection, not skipped as binary content.
API error handling should include retry logic or fallback to ensure critical files like PKGBUILD are always audited successfully.
